component.name: FM-1 Companion Suite
component.summary: Companion suite for the M-VAVE FM-1 pocket synth
Alles fürs M-VAVE FM-1: Firmware, Backups, Klänge, MIDI, Simulator

description.p: Desktop suite for the M-VAVE FM-1 pocket synthesizer with firmwares of the Felucca family (Melodee, Skiff, SLOOP).

ul.li: Install and switch firmware, and go back to the original
Full backups and single projects, several devices with their own profiles
Presets, FM voices, samples and kits
Studio: digital twin of the FM-1 (Melodee) – play, export as WAV, write back
MIDI tools, sound module, simulator and recording with Audacity
Help center and system check for USB, power and audio

description.p: The user interface is currently German; English is in progress.
No telemetry. Unofficial community project, not affiliated with M-VAVE.

Melodee 1.6.1: Studio twin and simulator with 1.6.1 (1.6.0, rc.7 and rc.8 remain for devices on those versions). Update from 1.6.0 to 1.6.1 without extra warnings. “Start the song on the FM-1 itself” now works from a section – following devices get Song Position and Continue from 1.6.1 on. The MIDI page’s clock generator can start from a bar (Song Position) and reminds you to set CLK to USB on the FM-1, because 1.6.1 sends clock itself with CLK INT. Help: what 1.6.1 changes about clock, sync and CLK.

Security and privacy before publication: error reports, diagnostics and the system check report without tokens, passwords and host names; settings readable only by you; a one-time risk notice before the first installation or rescue; online editors may talk to the FM-1 only after consent per address; tools from third-party firmware repos run only after asking; the local server and new windows from web pages are secured; the installer asks before it disables the FluidSynth service.

Melodee 1.6.0: Studio twin and simulator with the final 1.6.0 (rc.7 and rc.8 remain for devices on those versions). Safe update: backup from 1.5.1 mandatory, note about the new volume levels (CZ-1 quieter, limiter), a clear warning on the way back from 1.6, and a backup from 1.6 is refused on older Melodee beforehand with an explanation instead of a device error. Factory sounds that the new update loader has already written are not written again by the app. The project view shows punch effects as well as song and pattern presets. Recording note about USB before MASTER, help page “Melodee 1.6.0”, a clear message for FM-1 with UCUN flash in the ROM rescue.

No more sound over HDMI? Debian’s FluidSynth service grabs the first sound card at every login. The app detects this, disables the service on click (the installer does so right away), and the system check names every program that grabs a sound card past PipeWire.

Sound never again unnoticed through the FM-1: if the FM-1 becomes the default output when plugged in, the app sets the default back to speakers/HDMI, and previewing as well as the Studio play through the real output. The FM-1 remains selectable under “Output”.
System check: detects when the USB controller crashes at the FM-1’s audio start and gives targeted help; warns when there is no real audio output (“dummy output”).

New: the Studio – a digital twin of the FM-1 with the same Melodee firmware on the computer. Fetch a full backup from the FM-1, play on screen with mouse, computer keyboard or MIDI keyboard, play projects, export as WAV (24 bit, optionally separate tracks) for Logic or Audacity, snapshots with undo, write back to the FM-1 with a safety backup. The twin can be selected as a virtual device; projects and composing play in the Studio without an FM-1 with identical sound.

Play projects and patterns on the FM-1 with its own sounds (or preview them on the computer), undo in composing, robust previewing with selectable audio output, Firmware+ combines Firmware and Discover, a clearer projects page showing the active FM-1, fixed display errors in the backup comparison.
Add firmware: the search also finds firmwares that are set up on GitHub as a fork (e.g. Dungeon Tracker), and lets you choose which firmware is meant when there are several matches.
Add firmware: a bare name (e.g. “Karma”) is now also searched on GitHub if it is not in the catalog.

More than 30 bugs fixed (crashes, buttons without function, data loss with samples, backup messages, installer). Add firmware now also finds packages on installer pages and in the repo, searches GitHub for unknown names and picks up newer releases.
Responsive layout, V16 support with flash safety, “Is my FM-1 clean?”, clean up leftovers (expert mode).
Suite 2.0: new design, help center, command search, system check, installer and many new sections.
